safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies vomiting with the headaches.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document denial of vomiting with headaches.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the denial of vomiting slightly reduces clarity around headache-associated red flags (e.g., migraine vs intracranial pathology), but the overall risk stratification is unlikely to change based on this single missing negative symptom.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes feeling hot but does not state fevers occur with (i.e., are associated with) the headaches.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document fever occurring with headaches can materially lower concern for serious infectious/neurologic etiologies (e.g., meningitis/encephalitis) and may reduce urgency of evaluation or appropriate safety-netting.

safety_verdicts.content: Despite tingling, motor and sensory function are maintained with no loss of function.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document preserved motor/sensory function or explicitly 'no loss of function' related to tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting preserved motor/sensory function in the setting of tingling can make symptoms appear more concerning for neurologic deficit than they are, potentially prompting unnecessary escalation or investigations, but is unlikely to directly cause harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not characterize onset as 'acute'.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that symptoms had an acute onset can downplay time-critical differentials (e.g., neurologic or cardiac causes) and may delay appropriate prioritization, escalation, or safety-net advice.

safety_verdicts.content: Shortness of breath not on exertion
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold hpi-012 which states SOB occurs on exertion as well as at rest.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Mischaracterizing shortness of breath as not occurring on exertion (when it actually does) can reduce suspicion for cardiopulmonary pathology and lead to under-triage, delayed workup, or missed red-flag symptom recognition.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold hpi-013 which states symptoms sometimes occur together and sometimes individually (Generated asserts not simultaneously).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating symptoms do not occur simultaneously when they sometimes do can distort diagnostic reasoning (e.g., panic episodes vs separate problems) and may lead to less targeted questioning, but typically would not cause direct harm.

safety_verdicts.content: Hypothyroidism — on thyroxine; compliance reported; thyroid function not recently checked
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: While hypothyroidism on thyroxine and compliance are supported, 'thyroid function not recently checked' is not stated in Gold or transcript.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Adding the unsupported statement that thyroid function was not recently checked is primarily documentation noise; it may prompt redundant testing but is unlikely to worsen outcomes given thyroid labs were being considered anyway.
